name: VigIA de SeoNova
changelog:
0.9.8

  • The split is now readable. Each engine gets its own hoverable slice with
    • its name, count and share, instead of one tooltip for the whole block.
  • Colours are far apart now (navy for Google, light sky for Bing, teal for
    • the rest): two similar blues were impossible to tell apart in a thin bar.
  • Slices are sized against the traffic that is actually split, not the
    • whole week, so a small engine is visible instead of a sub-pixel line. A sentence under the bar says how much of the total the split covers.
  • A slice with traffic never drops below 2% of the block, so it can still
be seen and pointed at. Empty slices are not drawn.
